idea-plugin.name: Guttenbergovitz UI Theme
idea-plugin.description:
Guttenbergovitz UI Theme

A warm, vintage-inspired UI theme for JetBrains IDEs. Like a well-aged whiskey or a Miles Davis solo — complex but not overwhelming. Reduces blue light and visual noise while maintaining depth and character.


Features:

  • 🌙 Dark + Light variants — two meticulously crafted versions included
  • 🏝️ Full Islands Theme support — native experience on JetBrains 2025.3+ with floating panels, proper border radius, and transparent sidebar borders
  • ✨ New UI ready — complete support for the modern JetBrains UI (2023.3+)
  • 🎨 60+ themed components — tool windows, tabs, menus, dialogs, popups, notifications, welcome screen, search everywhere, and more
  • 🔗 Cross-platform parity — consistent colors across all ports (VS Code, Neovim, Vim, Zed, Helix, terminals), sourced from a single palette.json
  • 👁️ Reduced eye strain — warm browns and oranges replace cool blues, less blue light emission
  • 🎯 Intentional ANSI remap — blue → orange, magenta → warm red, cyan → warm green

Color Philosophy:

  • 📖 Inspired by vintage book printing and jazz aesthetics
  • 🔥 Less blue light, more warmth
  • 🎯 Minimal but meaningful highlighting — every color has a purpose
  • 📐 Readability first, beauty second (they usually align)
  • 🎺 "It's not the notes you play, it's the notes you don't play" — Miles Davis

Designed for all JetBrains IDEs: IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, PhpStorm, RubyMine, CLion, Rider, DataGrip, Android Studio.


Install the matching Guttenbergovitz editor color scheme (available on the Marketplace or via Settings → Editor → Color Scheme) for the complete experience.


📦 Note: This plugin themes the entire IDE interface. If you only want editor syntax colors, install the Guttenbergovitz color scheme separately — it's free and simpler to set up.
